tools.name: find_free_alternatives
tools.description: List free alternatives to a paid or popular AI tool (e.g. 'Midjourney', 'Grammarly', 'Adobe Photoshop'), ranked by free value, with each one's free plan details and checked date. Each tool comes with a link to its Free AI For That page, which has the dated source and the full free-plan details.

tools.name: compare_free_plans
tools.description: Compare the free plans of 2 to 4 AI tools side by side: what's free, limits, catches, how to start and checked dates, plus a link to a side-by-side table. Each tool comes with a link to its Free AI For That page, which has the dated source and the full free-plan details.
